prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

   config: {"home_intro": {"button_label": "Continue to Controls"}, "new_control_portal": {"headline": "Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Learn how to summon, move, and hide your pet directly from your desktop system tray.", "button_label": "Finish Setup", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click system tray icon to hide or summon pet", "style": "plain"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_control_portal"]}

   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Desktop Rendering Engine", "hint": "Initial setup may take a few moments while graphic assets render.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically saves and restores all your active pets across logins."}}

   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use clear, well-lit photos with full views for best custom pet rendering results."}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"button_label": "Start Control Tutorial"}, "new_interactive_flow": {"headline": "Test Your Desktop Pet Commands", "body": "Practice hiding and summoning your companion before completing onboarding.", "button_label": "Complete Onboarding", "layout": "card"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_interactive_flow"]}

   config: {"sign_in": {}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
6: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Companion Profile Summary Screen: Insert a pet summary review screen after adoption certificate confirmation to show chosen traits before waiting.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"button_label": "Review Pet Summary"}, "new_pet_summary": {"headline": "Pet Companion Passport", "body": "Your companion is ready to be loaded onto your desktop environment.", "button_label": "Proceed to Launch", "layout": "compact"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_pet_summary", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Asset Loading Checklist Indicator: Add a diagnostic component checklist to the waiting screen displaying real-time engine asset warmup stages.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Loading Desktop Pet Assets", "hint": "Checking graphics renderer, desktop overlay system, and sound engine readiness.", "show_progress": true}}
8: [adoption, notification] Photo Processing Audio Visual Alert Notification: Add a processing status badge notification on the photo upload screen during image generation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you as soon as your custom pet design is processed."}}
9: [finish, hint] Desktop System Tray Pet Quick Hint: Provide a persistent hint on the final home intro screen pointing to the system tray for pet access.

verdicts.reason: Valid addition of a new control portal screen following the home intro step.
Adding rendering status updates and estimated wait time to the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding an informative hint about account sync persistence to the sign-in screen is compliant.
Adding helpful formatting hints to the photo upload screen is allowed.
Adding a new interactive control testing flow after the home intro step is allowed.
Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Inserting a pet summary screen inside the onboarding flow is permitted.
Adding asset warmup checklist information to the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding photo processing status notification options is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a system tray navigation hint to the home intro screen is compliant.
